column1: # PREMISE_LEDGER.tsv - what premise machinery this author has already spent
# Frozen data file for check-premise-distinct.py. Seeded BY HAND by the author, which is
# the point: the population that matters is "premises this author has already used", and
# the author is the only person who knows that list. There is no corpus of published
# fiction that could tell us, and a gate that tried to infer it would be measuring the
# same thing NAME_FREQUENCY measures - what a model reaches for by default - which is
# this author's other gate's job and not this one's.
# FORMAT - tab separated, 6 columns, no tabs inside a field.
#   book <TAB> year <TAB> profession <TAB> engine <TAB> relationship <TAB> note
# THE THREE AXES, and why three.
#   profession     what the protagonist is employed as. The single most legible thing a
#                  blurb contains, and therefore the thing a reader uses to decide whether
#                  they have read this book before. "fire investigator" and "records
#                  clerk" are different jobs; two books that both open on a professional
#                  opening a case read alike regardless of what else differs.
#   engine         the machine the book runs on - the procedural, the relationship, the
#                  institutional pressure that generates the plot. This is the axis a
#                  trope detector would want and cannot reliably get. Written as a short
#                  gerund phrase so near-misses are visible.
#   relationship   the central human pair or the central dynamic, in the same shape.
#                  A book is not a job plus a trick; a book is a job plus a trick plus
#                  who is lying to whom.
# MATCH RULE
#   FAIL  when profession AND engine both match another row, or when all three match.
#   WARN  when exactly two of the three match.
#   Pass  on zero or one.
# Why FAIL needs TWO axes and not one. Two books with the same profession are extremely
# common and completely fine - every detective series ever written. Two books with the
# same profession AND the same engine is the same machine with a new coat, and that is
# the specific feeling of "I have read this". A gate that fired on profession alone
# would fail every book in every series ever, which is why it must not.
# SEEDED 2026-09-28 from the author's own catalogue. New rows are added when a book is
# FINISHED, not when it is started - a premise entered at Phase 0 would make the book
# collide with itself.
sons-of-heaven
hollow-bridge
